gameplay.inspiration: fast objective combat in the spirit of classic Day of Defeat gameplay

visual.rule: concept images are art-direction targets, not in-engine screenshots
visual.finalCaptureRule: only actual Hammer/CS2 rendered captures may be labeled in-engine screenshots

visual.priority: recognizable Spandau identity and gameplay readability before spectacle
